sources.title: executorch/examples/models/llama/README.md at main - GitHub
sources.snippet: For Llama 3.2 1B/3B models, we have enabled the original BF16 format and quantization to 4-bit, using SpinQuant and QAT+LoRA, for enhanced performance. The quantized models were optimized primarily for Arm CPU architecture by leveraging XNNPACK and Kleidi AI library. Work is underway to specifically enable quantization on mobile accelerators for Llama 1B/3B.
